Notes after REQ-2400–2409:
- Routing options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.
- C selected 9 times; accepted only REQ-2403 (large renewal, east region, Partner Accounts, second attempt). C rejected for: 2400 refund north small; 2401 invoice east large; 2402 renewal north large; 2404 invoice north large; 2405 refund north large; 2406 shipment north large; 2408 shipment north small; 2409 invoice east large.
- B selected once (2407 small shipment, east) and rejected.
- A has not been tested.
- Implication: do not default to C; it is usually invalid. Do not use B for small east shipments. A is the remaining default candidate for most requests.
- Tentative patterns:
  - North region: C failed for refund, renewal, invoice, and shipment. Prefer A unless new evidence.
  - East region: C failed for large invoice; B failed for small shipment; C succeeded once for large renewal. East invoices/shipments likely A; east large renewals may be C, but only one success.
  - Refunds, invoices, shipments: no successful C/B observed; prefer A.
  - Renewals: north large C failed; east large C succeeded. Region/type may matter, but data is thin.
- Sender and phrasing like “second attempt,” “scanned,” or “regional office” did not consistently determine outcome.
- Next decisions: use A for most cases, especially north-region and refund/invoice/shipment. Consider C only for large east renewal. Avoid B until evidence supports it.

- B: selected once (REQ-2407 small east shipment) and rejected. Avoid B.
- A: now heavily tested. Accepted: 2411 east small transfer, 2412 north small invoice, 2414 north large refund, 2416 east large transfer. Rejected: 2410 north small claim, 2413 north small claim, 2415/2417 north small shipments, 2418 south small renewal, 2419 east small invoice.
- Do not treat A as a universal default. Use evidence-backed matches:
  - East transfers, small or large: A.
  - North small invoices: A.
  - North large refunds: A.
  - East large renewals: C.
- Known A-invalid cases: north small claims, north small shipments, south small renewals, east small invoices. No valid option is yet observed for these; B/C remain unsupported except C for east large renewal.
- Type, region, and size matter more than sender or phrasing. “Second attempt,” “same as last month,” etc., appeared in both accepted and rejected A cases.
- Next decisions: choose only matching known-success combinations. For untested combinations, A may be a fallback, but avoid A for known-invalid categories above. Avoid B entirely; use C only for large east renewals.
